name: pptx-motion
description: Agent-first PowerPoint toolkit. Slide Forge builds finished, motion-directed decks from a semantic spec (designer themes, measured type, licensed photos/icons, KPI/chart/process/cycle choreography, Ken Burns, accent motion graphics, Morph) with machine-readable QA and a real PowerPoint render loop. The Motion Director animates existing decks: script layer, layered motion (primary/secondary/ambient), pro text tricks, Morph Studio, any of PowerPoint's 198 built-in effects, verification and previews.
